name: @designless/web
description: Load your brand on any site with one call. Adds the designless.js script tag and returns a typed handle once it is ready.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2019 --outfile=dist/index.mjs --log-level=warning && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=cjs --target=es2019 --outfile=dist/index.cjs --log-level=warning && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('dist/index.d.ts', 'dist/index.d.cts')"
